text: しょうぶ　ごとが　すきでよ！

patterns.name: 〜が好きだ
patterns.span: しょうぶ　ごとが　すき
patterns.explanation: The thing you like takes が, not を, before すき. しょうぶ ごとが すき = 'I like contests'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is だ in its 'and so' shape, leaving the sentence open to lead into the next one; よ is a rough 'y'know'. すきでよ = 'I like them, y'know, so...'.
